Notes: Mercenary recruiter by the striking workers outside Desmond Calitri's office. Hires the existing Doctor, Enforcer, Soldier and Keeper. The four camp recruiters stay.

hello.Text: Strikers on one side, Desmond on the other. I can put a mercenary on your side. Doctor, Enforcer, Soldier or Keeper. No charge.

doctor.Text: Done. Your Doctor will follow you and fight what fights you.{hiremerc doctor}

enforcer.Text: Done. Your Enforcer will follow you and fight what fights you.{hiremerc enforcer}

soldier.Text: Done. Your Soldier will follow you and fight what fights you.{hiremerc soldier}

keeper.Text: Done. Your Keeper will follow you and fight what fights you.{hiremerc keeper}

busy.Text: Sorry, I can't send anyone out right now.

dismiss.Text: {dismissmercs}All right, I'll call them back. Come see me any time you need them again.

how.Text: You can hire one of each kind: Doctor, Enforcer, Soldier and Keeper. They work like pets, so use the pet window or /pet commands to tell them to follow, guard, wait or attack. They leave when you log off or fall in battle; just come back and hire them again.
